verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page claims first-party CRM field sync that updates records automatically after meetings, and its webhooks expose CRM matches, so the product itself appears to provide the capability. The evidence is only one-line marketing mentions with no integration docs. missing for 10: named support for HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio, documentation that notes/summaries land on the correct contact and deal records, setup and mapping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
